title: Do Smaller Models Exhibit More Axiom-Consistent Preferences? A Scale Study

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: if axiom violations scale with model size, formal alignment frameworks become harder to apply at the capability frontier. This directly informs whether preference-based alignment is tractable for larger models. Each link is defensible.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Pythia models are freely available on HuggingFace at all listed sizes. Well within beginner reach with guidance.
